synopsis: Siemens Simcenter Prescan is a commercial ADAS/AV environment, traffic, scenario and sensor simulation tool, listed among complete or near-complete platforms [f8456, f8348]. Its models cover camera, radar, lidar and ultrasonic sensors, with reflective material properties, lighting, weather and radar phenomena [f8457, f15899]. It supports OpenSCENARIO and OpenDRIVE, plus Python and MATLAB APIs [f8616, f16237]. Evidence in the corpus is on-road only: public off-road heavy-machine validation was not found, and translating its road-centric scene semantics and material libraries to quarries and mines is considered non-trivial [f9003, f8461, f15951, f8462]. The latest release found was Prescan 2606, dated 2026, but its exact release date and public price were not found; sensor-model pricing is quote-only [f8459, f8460, f8541, f9006].
